## What changed

Describe the user-facing behavior and why it changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests
- [ ] TypeScript and lint
- [ ] Build and local browser flow, when UI or routes changed
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots, when behavior or visuals changed

List exact commands and results, including skipped checks.

## Privacy and release check

- [ ] No API keys, personal messages, one-time links or private data in code, fixtures, screenshots or logs
- [ ] Claims about AI accuracy, security, billing and production readiness match the evidence
- [ ] New environment variables are documented without real values
